allocation_semantics: Bound enabled video-clip request scopes and preflight binding count plus targetWidth*targetHeight*8*distinctAssetCount retained surface bytes before decode. Because every image must match the target, also prove the pngdecode-v1 peak width*height*20+2*(1+width*4) fits its frozen per-image working limit before reading bindings. Retained surfaces are immutable and shared by concurrent reads; scheduler-wide concurrent memory remains separate.
binding_semantics: Require exactly one caller binding for every distinct referenced image asset and no other binding. Every binding declares and exactly matches the frozen document hash. Each Document asset must contain a canonical lowercase sha256 content_hash, which must equal the hash of the complete strict PNG bytes. URI values are never opened or fetched.
cancellation_semantics: Check cancellation before and after document freezing, before every binding decode, inside strict PNG decode/normalization, after each decode and before publishing the complete provider. Request service checks before lookup and before returning a surface. Compile never returns a partial provider.
document_semantics: Canonical-validate, deep-freeze and hash one complete Document v2. Every enabled clip on a video track must reference an image asset; referenced image IDs and exact timeline/track/clip indexes are frozen as the only authorized request scopes.
evidence_semantics: The manifest is a deterministic provider record, not a signature, worker attestation or complete render proof. A caller must bind it together with the compositor result, execution identity and authorized resource resolution in an EvidenceManifest before treating it as evidence.
excluded_responsibilities: URI resolution, network/file authorization, video or animated-image decode, alternate PNG profiles, resize, crop, transform, rotation/SAR, masks, text/vector rasterization, output conversion, encoding, scheduling and publication are outside this profile.
receipt_semantics: Return a deterministic AssetID-sorted manifest binding document hash, asset identity, encoded-content and normalized-pixel hashes, geometry, sRGB intent and every decode/color/source/surface profile. Manifest slices are defensive copies.
request_semantics: Accept only the frozen document hash, authorized timeline/track/clip/asset/index tuple, valid exact time values, frozen target dimensions, reference-compositor source profile and CPU surface profile. Any mismatch fails without fallback.
static_image_semantics: A verified image is one immutable surface for every valid SourceTime of each authorized clip. SourceTime is validated but never used for temporal selection, edge holding or retiming.
